notes.title: Patch note - Ver. 1.1.4 -
notes.content:
In this update, we made the following changes:

[h3][b][Bugfixes][/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where clicking on a specific location on the title screen would exit the game.
[*]Fixed a display bug on the title screen.
[*]Fixed a bug where the color tone changes when returning to the title screen from a flashback scene.
[/list]
[h3][b][Changes][/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Deleted test save data that was left over.
[*]Improved the video quality of the opening movie.
[/list]
